about: Which part of a scheduled prompt, draft or status the page shows as its text. One rule in two languages: kazma_core.text_display.extract_post_body (server) and KazmaBidi.extractPostBody (bidi.js, used by the Scheduled page and X Studio). tests/test_text_display.py and tests/js/test_post_body_cases.js both read this file, so the two cannot drift: on 2026-09-28 the server copy was fixed and the page kept showing the owner's reminders as "done" from its own copy.

cases.name: the owner's reminder quotes the reply word it asks for
cases.text: ⏰ CANCELLATION REMINDER — CoPilot Pro+ renews on October 1, 2026. If you want to avoid the charge, cancel before the renewal date. Reply "done" to stop these daily reminders.
cases.body: ⏰ CANCELLATION REMINDER — CoPilot Pro+ renews on October 1, 2026. If you want to avoid the charge, cancel before the renewal date. Reply "done" to stop these daily reminders.

cases.name: a tweet quoting a phrase is the tweet
cases.text: Our motto is "ship it" and we mean it: every fix lands with a test.
cases.body: Our motto is "ship it" and we mean it: every fix lands with a test.

cases.name: a quote after a colon that does not end the text
cases.text: The rule: "ship it" -- and every fix lands with a test, always.
cases.body: The rule: "ship it" -- and every fix lands with a test, always.

cases.name: an arrow is not a blockquote
cases.text: Pipeline researcher -> writer finished in 12 seconds with no errors at all.
cases.body: Pipeline researcher -> writer finished in 12 seconds with no errors at all.

cases.name: a short Arabic tweet the wrapper hands over
cases.text: Rescheduled batch job 2/8 — POST ONE TWEET ONLY. Call x_post with EXACTLY this text: "كاظمه لا تجيب فقط — بل تنفّذ وفق جدول."
cases.body: كاظمه لا تجيب فقط — بل تنفّذ وفق جدول.

cases.name: a short post that is most of the prompt
cases.text: Post on X: "Kazma 0.12 is out, faster recall"

cases.name: an unclosed quote at the end of a long wrapper
cases.text: Rescheduled batch job 2/8 — POST ONE TWEET ONLY. Call x_post with EXACTLY this text (do not alter, translate, or add hashtags): "كاظمه لا تجيب فقط — بل تنفّذ وفق جدول. حدد مهمة في التاسعة صباحًا وستعم
cases.body: كاظمه لا تجيب فقط — بل تنفّذ وفق جدول. حدد مهمة في التاسعة صباحًا وستعم

cases.name: a status that hands the tweet over as a blockquote
cases.text: Status for batch job 2/8 — tweet posting: 1. **x_post attempted** with the exact locked text (unchanged, no extra hashtags): > كاظمه لا تجيب فقط — بل تنفّذ وفق جدول. حدد مهمة في التاسعة صباحًا وست
cases.body: كاظمه لا تجيب فقط — بل تنفّذ وفق جدول. حدد مهمة في التاسعة صباحًا وست
